lineItems.name: Signature Website Package
lineItems.invoiceDetail: Premium design with 4K hero video and photo enhancement, Shopify payment integration, SEO, AEO and GEO, contact forms, AI assistant, hosting with no monthly fee, and 90 days’ support.
lineItems.agreementDetail: Your new website, designed and built for Cosmo Lighting Kensington: premium design with a 4K hero video, Shopify payment integration, SEO, AEO and GEO, contact forms, an AI assistant, hosting with no monthly fee and 90 days’ support. Full details in section 3.

lineItems.name: Supplier Sync Agent + Postcode Shipping Calculator
lineItems.invoiceDetail: Live pricing, product range and stock status from Oz Lighting and Lighting Outlet, with freight built into your pricing, plus Australia Post delivery costs calculated from the customer’s postcode.
lineItems.agreementDetail: An automated agent that watches Oz Lighting and Lighting Outlet and keeps your website up to date: live prices, new and discontinued products, and in-stock / out-of-stock status. Your pricing rules include supplier freight costs, so freight increases flow into your prices instead of coming out of your margin. Includes the Postcode Shipping Calculator: customers enter their postcode and see an Australia Post delivery cost before they pay.

lineItems.name: Google Business Profile Optimisation

lineItems.agreementDetail: A full review and update of your Google Business Profile: categories, hours, description, products, photos and a simple way to ask customers for reviews.
